notes: Mobile Cycle 3 (M2): on-device supervision. An agent run on the phone writes its task record as it goes and saves a resumable context beside it; a run the app loses shows as Interrupted in the Tasks panel and offers Resume, a new segment briefed from the record, counting against the same per-task step budget. Approval waits in the background raise a notification naming only the task; tapping it opens the app at the pending approval.
